name: The Trollbane trial's Paragons and their guards are spawned where Ascension has them
contract: Hardcore - Trollbane (challenge 214, Prestige 428) requires killing Vazul 254168 before level 40, Zazera 254170 before 45 and Yahola 254169 before 59; none of them existed. Ascension footage and in-game .gps place Vazul (level 40 elite) in the Witherbark Village cave with two Elite Witherbark Headhunters 254176 (34-35), Zazera (45) on the Sandsorrow Watch tower in Tanaris, and Yahola (59) on the Mazra'Alor temple steps with the Left and Right Hand of Yahola 254172/254173 (59). On Ascension these trial NPCs are not raised by the open-world health scaling: Zazera took 13480 damage to kill (with overkill), her cached modifier 9.0 without scaling (13302), and Yahola has 68290 health, each Hand of Yahola 24935 and each Risen Servant 5420. Their modifiers are divided by our open-world health scaling at their level, so after it they land within 1 of those values. Health is asserted within 5% of them: tight enough to catch a creature left at the scaled or unscaled value, loose enough for rounding and small scaling retunes. Asserted from the world phase at each spot: the Paragon is there once at her level with her model and health and can be attacked, and her guards are there at theirs. Zazera burns with Burning Sands, spins into Firestorm in combat, and a Water Bucket splash puts the Burning Sands out and stuns her with Extinguished. In combat Vazul opens with Chains of Ice, and Yahola raises four Risen Servants with Army of the Dead once she falls below 99% health.
